title: Changelog accordion with panel wipe
summary: A bold title card on a saturated colour opens into three update categories; a white panel wipes up and each category unfolds its three items in turn, then folds away. The update log reads as one calm, paced list.
use_when: A what's-new or release-notes post for a social feed
Three groups of updates with up to three short items each
A silent autoplay vertical or 4:5 placement where text carries the message
A recurring changelog series that needs one reusable template

look.type_style: act 1: heavy grotesk title, sentence case, tight, ~4 % H, pale blue on brand blue; act 2: light serif category heads ~3 % H in black with line icons, small grotesk sub-items ~1.3 % H with arrow bullets

sfx.event: white panel wipes up over the blue act
a category unfolds and its items rise in

structure.shot: flat brand-blue field; a concentric square-and-ring backdrop pattern blooms from the centre, then a thin pale rule lands near the top
structure.camera: locked-off, no camera move; only the backdrop pattern scales
structure.motion: pattern grows from a point to full frame between 0.27 and 0.77 s (~15 fr, easings.outExpo, ±0.25 s); rule slides down into place by 1.00 s, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: small date label under the rule, two-word heavy title across the frame; pattern dims behind it; corner wordmark and footer URL stay fixed
structure.motion: title words mask-rise, second word ~2 fr behind the first (±0.25 s), springs.maskRise, settled by 1.50 s; rule and date ride up ~2 % H with springs.layout; pattern starts a slow rotation at 2.50 s

structure.shot: title shrinks to a header at top left; three category lines (icon + 1-2 words) build bottom-left; pattern rotates and enlarges behind; hold
structure.motion: header scales ~0.45x and moves up, springs.layout ~8 fr (2.77 to 3.27 s, ±0.25 s); categories mask-rise one per ~0.25 s (3.00, 3.27, 3.50 s), springs.maskRise; pattern rotation ~45 deg over 2.50 to 3.00 s, easings.outQuint; hold 1.50 s

structure.shot: white panel rises from the bottom over everything but a thin blue top band; category list moves to the top in black; first category unfolds three short items with arrow bullets
structure.motion: panel wipe 22 fr (f158 to f180, easings.inOutSine); list rides up with the panel, springs.layout; item lines mask-rise per word, line stagger ~3 fr (±0.25 s), settled by 6.50 s; lower categories push down on springs.layout; hold 2.25 s

structure.shot: first category folds, second category climbs under it and unfolds its three items; faint line-art mark in the lower half fades out; hold
structure.motion: items exit up through their masks per word, ~8 fr (8.77 to 9.00 s, ±0.25 s); rows close up on springs.layout; new items mask-rise 9.50 to 10.27 s, line stagger ~3 fr (±0.25 s); line-art mark fades ~8 fr at 10.00 to 10.27 s; hold 2.00 s

structure.shot: second category folds, third climbs and unfolds its three items; all three heads stacked with the last one open; long end hold with footer URL
structure.motion: same fold 12.27 to 12.77 s and unfold 13.00 to 13.77 s as row 5 (springs.layout, springs.maskRise, ±0.25 s); then nothing moves for 4.63 s to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: accent fills act 1, bg (white) fills act 2, display font for the title, serif for category heads
params.content.date: small date label above the title
params.content.title: title card, 1-2 words
params.content.categories: 3 groups, each {icon, label (1-2 words), items: 3 lines of 3-5 words}
params.content.url: footer link line, shown the whole film
params.timing.unfold: frames per category from unfold to fold (default 105 = 3.5 s)
params.timing.endHold: frames the last open category holds (default 139)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: No hard cuts; the film is one list in two acts split by a 22 fr panel wipe (f158 to f180). Category period 3.5 s (105 fr) measured from sheets at 0.25 s resolution. Catalogue hint card-grid not seen: there are no cards, the updates are an accordion list. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): accordion-list, pattern-bloom. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). The last row holds 4.6 s with no motion; shorten it for feeds.
